==Description==
The '''Actor2''', called the '''Actor''' in-game, was the fourth enemy that appeared in the [[The Great Finale|third act]] of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a high amount of health and defense for its debut, but a below average speed.

==Appearance==
The '''Actor2''' was an armored black humanoid that wore a white colored happy theater mask. It wore a horned helmet, grey chestplate, brown gloves, brown boots and a dark purple shirt.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can be very useful against this.
**Multiple weaker towers, like the [[Ace Pilot]] or Level 1-2 [[Golden Soldier]] can also be effective against this.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can also be useful at boosting the firerate and range of these towers.
*The [[Warden]] can be effective at slowing down and damaging the '''Actor2''' though is generally not necessary if you have enough DPS.
